title: Maximize Your Ad Spend with Facebook Lookalike Audiences | Brolik - A Marketing Agency

facts.fact: An estimated $58.11 billion is to be spent by advertisers on Facebook ads in the year the article was written.
facts.as_of: this year (article date not stated; likely 2022)
facts.quote: with an estimated $58.11 billion to be spent by advertisers this year on Facebook ads alone

facts.fact: Apple's iOS 14 privacy update requires apps to get explicit permission from users to track them.
facts.quote: With Apple’s launch of the privacy-focused iOS 14 last year, which requires apps to get explicit permission from users to track them

facts.fact: The article suggests an email subscriber list with high engagement can be considered strong when it has 30+% open rates or 20+% click rates.
facts.quote: If you have an email subscriber list with high engagement rates (think 30+% open rates or 20+% click rates)

facts.fact: Facebook's Customer Value Audiences let advertisers indicate customer value by adding lifetime spend or another ranking to customer lists.
facts.quote: you can indicate a customer’s value to your business by adding their lifetime spend or some other ranking

facts.fact: Brolik reported that on its earlier audience for a client's traffic campaign, Facebook ad cost per click was around $1 with a 1.05% click-through rate.
facts.quote: we were seeing cost per clicks (CPC) on ads around $1, with a 1.05% click through rate (CTR)

facts.fact: Brolik reported a 0.7% conversion rate to scheduling appointments and a cost per acquisition around $200 for the earlier audience on a client campaign.
facts.quote: we saw a 0.7% conversion rate for scheduling appointments with a final cost per acquisition (CPA) around $200

facts.fact: Brolik said that after implementing lookalike audiences and more targeted ads, it reduced the client's cost per acquisition by half to $110.
facts.quote: we were able to reduce our CPA by half to $110

facts.fact: Brolik reported that with its updated targeting, Facebook ad cost per click dropped to $0.24 and click-through rate rose to 1.2%.
facts.quote: we saw a drop from to $0.24 CPC and increase in CTR to 1.2%

facts.fact: For a B2B client serving nonprofits and associations, Brolik's interest-based Facebook campaign collected four leads in two weeks at an average cost of $64.14 per lead.
facts.quote: we collected four leads in two weeks at an average cost of $64.14 per lead

facts.fact: Brolik reported that a lead-based lookalike audience reduced cost per acquisition to $34.34 across 15 leads collected in two weeks for the B2B nonprofit client.
facts.quote: We were able to drop the CPA to $34.34 on 15 leads in two weeks

facts.fact: Brolik reported that a broad location-based Facebook audience for a medical client produced a 4.42% click-through rate at $0.21 per click.
facts.quote: we saw a 4.42% CTR at $0.21 per click

facts.fact: Brolik reported a 1.02% conversion rate on the sign-up form for users from the broad location-based audience for a medical client.
facts.quote: we saw a 1.02% conversion rate on our sign up form

facts.fact: Brolik reported that a lookalike audience built from a client's customer list and prior leads achieved a 5.05% click-through rate at $0.21 per click and a 1.16% conversion rate.
facts.quote: We were happy with the results with a 5.05% CTR at $0.21 per click, and especially the increased 1.16% conversion rate

facts.fact: Brolik states that Facebook demographic targeting options are likely to disappear in the next few years.
facts.quote: As demographic targeting options on Facebook are likely to disappear in the next few years
